# The Unified System — a sovereign capability foundry

> A sovereign, proof-carrying operating estate that renders enterprise reality on local silicon, recycles its own compute through geometric memory, and turns any individual with a Kard into an autonomous, self-powering node in a decentralized mesh. Composed, not merged — open under MIT.

Three minds resolve into one pipeline: a structural lattice (Thomas Frumkin / Konomi — low-discrepancy golden-ratio memory placement), a thermodynamic law (Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — inference governed by entropy, render on observation, GEP/NEXUS), and a thermodynamic pump (Simon Gant / FallForge — the Fold-Cycle recycles held compute: 95% prefill, 67% embedding). A node opens a FallKard, then seven stages: Prove, Own, Shape, Carry, Remember, Run cheap, Connect. Contribution is a closed KCC credit now, designed to settle as premined contribution on BSV via Thomas Frumkin's MCP downstream. Every stage has a live door.

## Live doors
- fall-os — https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-os/
- fall-federate / join (federate over WebRTC) — https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-federate/join/
- kar-foldcycle (the compute pump) — https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/kar-foldcycle/
- fallforgemint (mint a model) — https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fallforgemint/
